about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-76, part of the 'cover ALL' decomposition (XC-54 to XC-78) drafted on 2026-10-25 from public sources. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. It becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. Every criterion except scope, pushed and the unchanged-suite guards fails on the v1.6.0 tree. Evidence is testnet-only, loopback-only and verify-only unless the task says otherwise; hosted facilitators are never called. Estimated effort: 3-4 days.

not_contract_tasks.keys: Throwaway testnet keys and faucet tokens are created on the owner's machine and live in X402C_KEYS outside the repository. No spend, no mainnet.
not_contract_tasks.disclosure: A failing third-party column is reported to that project privately first (SECURITY.md). Until the window clears its row says 'under disclosure' with no per-check detail.

tasks.title: Industry matrix v2: a faceted, evidence-only scoreboard with parity and coverage views
tasks.description: Extends XC-52 without changing its rules: still static, still built only from committed evidence, still no composite score and no 'certified'. Adds facets so anyone can see how the industry (every facilitator, SDK and vendor with evidence) stands on each check, plus the parity and coverage views. After 2027-01-21 rows whose disclosure window has cleared show per-check detail automatically; nothing in this task changes that rule.

criteria.statement: The scoreboard can be filtered by role, language, project, deployment (self-hosted, library offline, hosted read-only), chain family, network, scheme, transfer method, x402 version and transport, and by check profile and USENIX rule, all computed from committed evidence
A parity view shows, per vector, the outcome of each SDK side by side
A coverage view shows, per chain family and language, how many rows have evidence, a task or an out-of-reach reason
The page has no composite score, rank or 'certified' wording
No third-party row under disclosure exposes a per-check result, in HTML or JSON
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.

Testnet only: never use a mainnet CAIP-2 id, never fund a key with anything but testnet faucet tokens, never call a hosted facilitator; every facilitator under test is the owner's own instance on 127.0.0.1.
A failing third-party result is not published with per-check detail until SECURITY.md's disclosure window clears; if a criterion would need that detail to pass, STOP and report.
